title: Norwegian Skillet Knaefla
description: A traditional Norwegian flatbread, perfect for serving with soups or stews. This skillet version is easy to make and delicious.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, yeast, and warm water. Mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add oil and sauté mushrooms until softened.
Divide dough into 2-3 equal pieces, depending on desired thickness.
Roll out each piece to a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Cook the flatbreads in the skillet for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
Serve with soups, stews, or enjoy on its own.
